tierReason: Issue #16 is one Feature from the MVP Epic; adds event and mute tables plus mute settings API

decisions.decision: Tier Feature with Sensitive Areas schema, data, public-api
decisions.why: One Epic Feature whose blockers are closed; adds event and mute tables and new endpoints.

decisions.decision: Activity feed, read state and bell dot are part of #16
decisions.why: The user asked to add the in-app feed on 2026-11-25 and approved the mockup with a dot instead of a count.

decisions.decision: Bell sits on the Home header, not the project list
decisions.why: Home is the first screen; the user approved it in the mockup.

decisions.decision: Recipient rows double as push queue, feed and read state; 1-min timer plus tick recovery
decisions.why: One source of truth; the tick alone would delay pushes up to 5 minutes.

decisions.decision: Prior Art: reuse PushSender and extract catchUp send/settle into push/deliver.ts; claim SQL written new
decisions.why: The send/settle part is generic; the reminder claim keys are not.

decisions.decision: Offline mark-read uses a small pending-read set, not sync/queue.ts
decisions.why: Mark-read is idempotent and the queue is built for entity changes; a past lesson warns against folding odd changes into it.

findings.text: apps/api/src/activity/scheduler.ts: only one timer for the earliest dueAt and no re-arm after a flush; user B's event due at T+90s while A's timer fires at T+60s waits for the 5-min tick (up to ~4 min late), same for retries. R12 says about 1 minute. Fix: after each flush re-arm for the earliest remaining pending dueAt/retry time.
apps/api/src/activity/record.ts open-window lookup uses dueAt > now: an unsent row whose window already ended makes a new event open a fresh 60s window, so two pushes for one project. Cosmetic.

apps/api/src/internal/routes.ts /tick: flushActivity runs after runCatchUp in one try; a throw in runCatchUp skips activity pushes, a throw in flushActivity returns 500 and skips cleanup. Fix: run them independently.

apps/api/src/push/activity.ts L149-154: data.eventIds is unbounded; a group of ~90+ events exceeds Expo's 4 KB payload limit, every send fails, after 3 tries all rows are dropped (still in feed). Fix: cap eventIds (e.g. newest 50) or split groups.

apps/api/src/push/activity.ts L121-163: attempts is incremented before send and sent is settled after; a crash between Expo accepting and settle leaves rows pending and a retry 2 min later sends them again (duplicate push, against R15). Accept and document as at-least-once, or mark sent before sending.

apps/api/src/activity/routes.ts L95-99, L115-119: upsert on userId_type / userId_projectId may raise P2002 under two identical concurrent PUTs (double tap, offline replay) -> 500, against R23. Fix: treat unique violation as success or createMany skipDuplicates.

apps/api/src/internal/routes.ts /tick: a throw in flushActivity returns 500 after reminders were sent and skips the 30-day cleanup (same area as finding 3). Fix: wrap flushActivity in its own try/catch.

apps/mobile/src/activity/ActivityProvider.tsx markAllAsRead (~L199-216): offline 'Đọc hết' only re-queues loaded unread ids; unread events on unloaded pages come back unread after reconnect (50 unread, 30 loaded -> 20 return). Fix: queue a read-all marker and resend markAllActivityRead on reconnect.

apps/mobile/src/notifications/useNotificationSettings.ts L29-45: a slow load() finishing after a switch flip calls show(server) and overwrites the optimistic value; switch jumps back briefly. Fix: ignore loads started before the latest change (generation counter).
apps/mobile/src/notifications/useNotificationSettings.ts L36-37: getToken() null leaves status 'loading' forever (only while signed out).
apps/mobile/src/activity/ActivityProvider.tsx loadMore: no generation check after awaits; a slow page across sign-out/sign-in could append stale rows (store remounts per user, low risk).

apps/mobile/src/activity/ActivityProvider.tsx markAllAsRead/flushReadAll: the offline read-all marker has no time bound, so when sent it also marks events that arrived after the tap. Probably acceptable.

apps/api/src/activity/scheduler.ts: re-arm reads nextDueAt through an untyped cast on flush()'s result; a refactor of the index.ts wrapper could silently drop re-arming. A typed return would be safer.
apps/api/src/internal/routes.ts: if reminders and activity both fail in one tick, only the first error is returned; the second is only logged.

1.evidence: record.test.ts 'assigned (AC1)': create notifies others not creator; PATCH records only newly added; idea->task records assigned. Full API suite 866/866.
1.criterion: API test: editing a task from assignees {A} to {A, B} as C notifies B only. Creating a task with assignees {A, B} as A notifies B. Converting an idea to a task with assignees creates "assigned" events for those assignees.

2.evidence: record.test.ts 'comment (AC2)': creator, assignees, earlier commenters, not author; remindWith same.
2.criterion: API test: on a task created by A, assigned to B and commented on earlier by D, a comment by B notifies A and D but not B. A comment with "Nhắc kèm" behaves the same.

3.evidence: record.test.ts 'done (AC3)': todo->done notifies all involved but actor; todo->doing and done->todo nothing; done->todo->done second event.
3.criterion: API test: todo → done notifies the creator, assignees and commenters, except the person who acted. Done → todo and todo → doing send nothing. Done → todo → done sends a second Done.

4.criterion: API test: creating an idea in a project with members A, B and C, as A, notifies B and C.

5.evidence: record.test.ts 'member joined (AC5)': existing members notified, joiner not.
5.criterion: API test: when D joins a project with members A and B through an invite, A and B are notified and D is not.

6.evidence: record.test.ts 'never includes the actor, in any path (AC6)'.
6.criterion: Covered by tests 1-5. In each, the actor has no event addressed to them.

7.evidence: push/activity.test.ts: nothing sent when recipient left or task/idea deleted; valid events in same batch kept (AC7).
7.criterion: API test: if a recipient leaves the project, or the task is deleted, before the window ends, nothing is sent to them for that event.

8.evidence: record.test.ts: LWW-rejected PATCH and repeated client-id create add nothing (AC8).
8.criterion: API test: a PATCH that last-write-wins rejects, or a repeated create with the same client id, adds no event.

9.evidence: record.test.ts 'late edits (AC9)': 61 min -> late, no dueAt; 59 min -> pending.
9.criterion: API test: an assignment whose recorded edit time is 61 minutes before the request is applied but adds no event. One at 59 minutes adds an event.

10.evidence: record.test.ts 'other changes record nothing (AC10)'; catchUp.test.ts reminder tests pass in full suite.
10.criterion: API test: changing an ingredient price, a task title, a checklist item, a vote, a role, or a member leaving adds no event. The existing reminder tests still pass.

11.evidence: record.test.ts 'transaction (AC11)': failed request leaves no event; rows vanish when tx fails.
11.criterion: API test: the event row is written in the same transaction as the change. If the change rolls back, there is no event.

12.evidence: activity.test.ts (AC12): nothing before window ends, then one push; later event opens own window, second push.
12.criterion: API test with a fake clock and the fake sender: two events for one recipient 20 seconds apart arrive in one push at about 1 minute. An event at 90 seconds goes in a second push.

13.evidence: activity.test.ts (AC13) one push per project titled by project, 3 lines + more count in user language; activityText.test.ts VI/EN wording.
13.criterion: API test: events from two projects give two pushes, each titled with its project name. Five events in one project give 3 lines plus "+2 more" in English or "+2 nữa" in Vietnamese, following `User.language`.

14.evidence: activity.test.ts (AC14): tick without timer sends due batches; >1h event dropped; scheduler.test.ts covers timer.
14.criterion: API test: with the in-process timer off, a tick sends batches whose window has ended. An event older than 1 hour is marked dropped and not sent.

15.evidence: activity.test.ts (AC15): all devices; concurrent flushes and flush+tick send each event once.
15.criterion: API test: a recipient with two tokens gets the push on both. Running the timer and a tick at the same time sends each event once.

16.evidence: activity.test.ts (AC16): max 3 retries, recovery, DeviceNotRegistered deleted, no sender no error.
16.criterion: API test: a failing sender is retried at most 3 times within an hour. A `DeviceNotRegistered` token is deleted. With no push sender set, the tick and the timer finish without error.

17.evidence: routes.test.ts 'starts with every type on and no project muted'.
17.criterion: API test: a new user's settings show all five types on and no muted projects.

testHandoff.what: AC18, AC19, AC22: notification switches stop pushes
testHandoff.steps: Two iPhones in Expo Go, accounts A and B in projects P and Q. On A: Account > Thông báo, turn off 'Bình luận mới'. B comments on a task A is on, in P, then marks it Done. Expected: A gets no comment push but gets the Done push; the section shows the note that reminders can't be turned off. On A's project P screen turn off 'Thông báo hoạt động'; B adds an idea in P and one in Q. Expected: only Q's arrives. Compare with mockup 4a and 5a-5b.

testHandoff.what: AC24, AC25, AC31: push batching, banner and taps
testHandoff.steps: A locks the phone. Within one minute B comments twice on one task in P. Expected: one push titled P with both lines, about 1 minute after the first; tap opens that task and those rows lose the unread dot in Hoạt động. Repeat with a new idea (opens the idea), B's friend joining via invite (opens Thành viên), and mixed events (opens the project screen). With A's app open, an activity push shows as a dark banner (mockup 1c).

testHandoff.what: AC26, AC30, AC32, AC34: Activity screen and bell vs mockup
testHandoff.steps: On A: Home shows a bell with an orange dot when there is unread activity, none after 'Đọc hết'; tap the bell opens Hoạt động, back returns Home. Check rows grouped Hôm nay/Hôm qua/Trước đó with icons and relative times, empty state on a fresh account, placeholder rows while loading, airplane mode keeps the list with 'Đang ngoại tuyến' and 'Đọc hết' offline syncs after reconnect. Check light/dark, VI/EN, and VoiceOver reads the bell and switch names. Compare with mockup 2a-3e and 6a-6b.
